results.title: Best Gaming PC for Minecraft Shaders & Modpacks – pcgamingcases.co.uk
results.content:
Modded Minecraft behaves differently from shaders. Instead of pushing your GPU, large modpacks such as All The Mods, RLCraft, or Enigmatica lean on RAM and CPU threading. Each mod adds extra entities, calculations, and background processes. The more mods you run, the more memory the game needs allocated to it directly, not just installed on your system. [...] ## Quick Answer

The best gaming PC for Minecraft shaders and modpacks needs three things. First, a fast single core CPU for smooth world generation. Second, at least 16GB of RAM, or 32GB for heavy modpacks. Third, a mid range GPU with 8GB or more VRAM to handle shader packs like Complementary or BSL without frame drops. A build with a Ryzen 5 or Core i5 processor, an RTX 4060 or RTX 5060, and 16GB to 32GB of RAM covers most players comfortably at 1080p or 1440p. [...] Vanilla Minecraft: CPU dependent, runs on almost anything
 Minecraft with shaders: GPU and VRAM dependent
 Modded Minecraft (modpacks): RAM and CPU dependent, with GPU load increasing if the modpack includes visual mods

Understanding which category you fall into is the first step to choosing the right PC.
